reviewItem.question: Does "Line added to cmd/crossplane/core/core.go: return errors.New(\"Crossplane removed support for external secret stores. The --enable-external-secret-stores flag…" mean a change to cli-flag:crossplane|name=--enable-external-secret-stores|component=core (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: In Crossplane v2.0.0 support for external secret stores was removed, and the core command (cmd/crossplane/core/core.go) now returns the error "Crossplane removed support for external secret stores. The --enable-external-secret-stores flag will be removed in a future release." when the --enable-external-secret-stores flag is used.
